title: UI风格#90 - Art Space Minimal (艺术空间极简)
description: 创建第90种UI风格：艺术空间极简风格 - 白盒子画廊、巨额艺术品、纯白空间。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planCL.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Art Space Minimal style When color palette Then features pure white, black, gray, single artwork accent
Given Art Space Minimal style When typography Then uses gallery fonts: Cormorant, EB Garamond, or Bodoni Moda
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: Cormorant (headers 2.8rem 400 weight), EB Garamond (body 1rem 400-600 weight)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Art Space Minimal style When layout Then white cube gallery, single focal artwork, generous whitespace
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: pure white background, thin black border at top, generous whitespace, thin divider lines, large padding, understated elegance

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Art Space Minimal style When UI elements Then subtle shadows, artwork frames, minimal chrome
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: subtle shadows on cards, thin black borders, scaleX transform on hover, clean minimalist aesthetic, black/white/gray palette

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Art Space Minimal UI When functional Then includes gallery chat, curator agents, collection stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: white cube gallery chat, 4 curator agents (Rothko/Minimal/Mondrian/O'Keeffe) with Works/Vision/Pieces/Purity/Balance/Grid/Flowers/Detail stats

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Art Space Minimal UI When copy Then uses gallery speak: 'Collection', 'Curator', 'Exhibition', 'Minimal'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: title 'COLLECTION. CURATOR. EXHIBITION.', tagline 'Where art breathes', button 'VIEW', greeting 'The gallery awaits its next acquisition', status 'Active'/'Idle', nav 'Space'/'Studio'/'Archive'/'Atrium'
